1.1 Look at the pictures. In pairs, ask and answer the following

a) Have you ever gone to a library?
b) What do you do in the library?

1.2 Read and act out.

subject: English
text:
Rina and Omar are in the public library. They have come to the library to
read books. Today, they have seen a new girl in the library. She is looking
for some books on the bookshelves. On their way back home, they become
introduced and have a conversation.
Rina: Hello! My name is Rina. Are you new here?

subject: English
text:
Rupa: Hi! I'm Rupa. My family has just moved to this neighbourhood.
Omar: Hi Rupa! I'm Omar. It seems you like reading books.
Rupa: Yes, I love reading books.
Rina: What kind of books do you like to read?

I enjoy reading biographies of famous people.

subject: English

That sounds wonderful! Would you like to share your choice,
Rina?
Sure! I find science fiction very interesting.
Yes, I'm also fond of reading science fiction.
Have you borrowed any books today?
No, I couldn't. I am waiting for the library card.
It is nice meeting you, Rupa.
Pleased to meet you, too. Will you come to the library tomorrow?
Yes, hopefully after school we will be here.

subject: English

Great! See you tomorrow, Rupa and Omar.
